title: AGENTS.md: replace the README, and keep every skill generic
body:
Moves the content of `README.md` into `AGENTS.md` and deletes `README.md`. GitHub does not show `AGENTS.md` on the repository's front page.

Adds one rule for agents that change this repo: keep every skill generic, and do not fit a skill to the case that prompted the change.
